class Animal { name = 'animal'; }
class Dog extends Animal { bark() { return 'woof'; } }

const handlers = {
  method(dog: Dog) { return dog.bark(); },
  arrow: (animal: Animal) => animal.name,
  functionProperty: function (animal: Animal) { return animal.name; },
  get accessor() { return (animal: Animal) => animal.name; },
};

const extracted: (animal: Animal) => string = handlers.method;
const arrow: typeof handlers.arrow = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
const functionProperty: typeof handlers.functionProperty = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
const accessor: typeof handlers.accessor = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
